title: Why 70% of ERP projects fall short of their goals
takeaways: 70% of ERP initiatives miss original business goals.
Only 55% of ERP projects finish within budget.
Median ERP project cost was $450,000 in 2025.
Deployment time fell from 15.5 to nine months.
71.48% of new ERP licences in India were cloud.
source_note: Sources: Gartner 2025; Panorama Consulting 2024, 2025; Mordor Intelligence 2026
